We substitute $t=\frac{\pi }{3}$ into our function, and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(\frac{\pi }{3}) & =⟨6\operatorname{cos}⁡(5\cdot \frac{\pi }{3}),\,{sin}^{2}⁡(5\cdot \frac{\pi }{3})⟩ \\  & =⟨(6\cdot \frac{1}{2}),\,{(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2})}^{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨3,\,\frac{3}{4}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
